name: Gilneas Liberation Front Base Camp
summary: The Gilneas Liberation Front Base Camp serves as a fortified forward outpost in southern Silverpine Forest. Under the command of Lorna Crowley, Gilnean fighters and allied worgen coordinate their efforts here to push back against Forsaken expansion.

sections.title: A Forward Redoubt
sections.body: Tucked away in the dense woods of southern Silverpine Forest, this camp serves as the staging ground for the Gilneas Liberation Front. Led directly by Commander Lorna Crowley, the base is staffed by hardened Worgen Warbringers determined to defend their people's homeland from the encroaching Undercity forces. It serves as both a vanguard against Forsaken incursions and a vital command post coordinating resistance in the region.

sections.title: Forsaken Target
sections.body: Because of its strategic placement and the high-ranking leadership stationed within, the base camp is a primary focal point for Horde military operations in the forest. Forsaken scouts and agents under Lord Godfrey have set their sights directly on the camp, seeking to breach its perimeter, neutralize its elite warbringers, and capture Commander Crowley to dismantle the Gilnean resistance from the top down.

faq.q: What is the Gilneas Liberation Front Base Camp?
faq.answer: It is an armed outpost in southern Silverpine Forest used by Gilnean resistance fighters and worgen to coordinate operations against Forsaken expansion.
The outpost is headed by Commander Lorna Crowley, who directs the local fighters and organizes strikes against advancing undead forces.

faq.q: Why are the troops here so heavily armed?
faq.answer: The camp is manned by elite Worgen Warbringers assigned to guard Lorna Crowley and maintain a firm military presence against relentless Forsaken attacks.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this location?
faq.answer: Forsaken command views the base as the primary hub of Gilnean resistance in Silverpine Forest. Eliminating its guards and capturing Commander Crowley would crush local resistance efforts.

angles.text: This forward position represents a critical line of defense for Gilnean forces trying to hold their territory and resist total Forsaken conquest in the north.
For the Forsaken, breaking this camp and capturing Lorna Crowley is essential to securing Silverpine Forest and protecting the approaches to the Undercity.
